customScenarioText:
Title: Project Phoenix - Cross-Workload Agents Immersion
Description: Contoso Manufacturing is driving Project Phoenix, its flagship transformation program, alongside a parallel Q2 Cloud Migration initiative, while defending against competitor Fabrikam. Across Outlook, Teams channels, meetings, and files, Copilot and agents reason over the full thread of work - surfacing risks, drafting executive updates, reconciling the project and migration plans, and preparing a competitive response - so leaders can immerse in how Cowork connects email, chat, documents, meetings, and calendar into one coherent narrative.
